info.name: FinCore - Beneficiary Management API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Beneficiary Management API endpoints. Includes business user operations (create, update, delete, search, submit) and admin operations (approve, reject, suspend, statistics).

**Version**: 2.2.0
**Base URL**: {{base_url}}/api/beneficiaries
**Auth**: JWT Bearer Token ({{jwt_token}})

## Prerequisites
1. Login via Authentication API to get JWT token
2. Set {{jwt_token}} environment variable
3. Set {{base_url}} to your API endpoint

## User Types
- **Business User**: Can manage own beneficiaries (max 20)
- **Admin**: Can approve/reject/suspend any beneficiary

## Workflow
1. Business User creates beneficiary (status: PENDING)
2. Business User uploads 3-4 KYC documents
3. Business User submits for review (status: UNDER_REVIEW)
4. Admin approves/rejects beneficiary
5. If approved: status becomes ACTIVE
6. Admin can suspend ACTIVE beneficiaries

request.description:
Create a new beneficiary. Status will be PENDING.

**Required Fields**:
- beneficiaryName (2-255 chars)
- country
- registeredAddressId (must be valid address ID)

**C2C Validation**:
- If isCounterOverCounter = true, collectorContactNumber is required

**Business Rule**: User can have maximum 20 beneficiaries

request.description:
Update a beneficiary.

**Restriction**: Only PENDING beneficiaries can be updated

**Business Rule**: Once submitted (UNDER_REVIEW), beneficiary cannot be edited until rejected

Delete a beneficiary.

**Restriction**: Only PENDING beneficiaries can be deleted

**Side Effect**: Deletes associated KYC documents from Google Cloud Storage

Submit beneficiary for admin review.

**Prerequisites**:
- Status must be PENDING
- All required KYC documents must be uploaded:
  * CLIENT_AUTHORISATION_LETTER
  * BENEFICIARY_COMPANY_KYC
  * BENEFICIARY_AGREEMENT
  * COLLECTOR_IDENTIFICATION (if C2C)

**Status Change**: PENDING → UNDER_REVIEW

**Document Status Change**: All documents → UNDER_REVIEW

Get beneficiary count and limit information.

**Response**:
```json
{
  "count": 5,
  "limit": 20,
  "remaining": 15,
  "canCreateMore": true
}
```

**Use Case**: Display remaining beneficiary slots in UI

item.name: Admin Operations

request.description:
Get all beneficiaries across all users.

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Use Case**: Admin dashboard showing all beneficiaries in system

Get beneficiaries awaiting approval (UNDER_REVIEW status).

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Use Case**: Approval queue for compliance team

Approve a beneficiary.

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Prerequisites**: Status must be UNDER_REVIEW

**Status Change**: UNDER_REVIEW → ACTIVE

**Document Status Change**: All documents → VERIFIED

**Side Effect**: Clears any previous rejection reasons

Reject a beneficiary with reason.

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Prerequisites**: Status must be UNDER_REVIEW

**Required**: Reason (10-255 characters)

**Status Change**: UNDER_REVIEW → REJECTED

**Document Status Change**: All documents → REJECTED

**Note**: Rejection is permanent. User must create new beneficiary.

Suspend an active beneficiary with reason.

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Prerequisites**: Status must be ACTIVE

**Required**: Reason (10-255 characters)

**Status Change**: ACTIVE → SUSPENDED

**Use Case**: Temporary suspension for compliance investigation

**Note**: Can be reactivated later

Reactivate a suspended beneficiary.

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Prerequisites**: Status must be SUSPENDED

**Status Change**: SUSPENDED → ACTIVE

**Side Effect**: Clears suspension reason

Search beneficiaries across all users.

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Search Fields**:
- Beneficiary Name
- Nick Name
- Business Name

**Returns**: All matching beneficiaries regardless of owner

Get beneficiary statistics for admin dashboard.

**Access**: SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER only

**Response**:
```json
{
  "totalBeneficiaries": 150,
  "pendingCount": 25,
  "underReviewCount": 10,
  "activeCount": 100,
  "rejectedCount": 10,
  "suspendedCount": 5,
  "averageBeneficiariesPerUser": 7.5,
  "c2cCount": 30,
  "topCountries": [
    {"country": "United Kingdom", "count": 45},
    {"country": "Nigeria", "count": 30},
    {"country": "India", "count": 25}
  ]
}
```

**Use Case**: Admin analytics dashboard

item.name: KYC Documents (Beneficiary)

request.description:
Get all KYC documents for a beneficiary.

**Returns**: Array of document metadata (not files)

**Document Types for Beneficiaries**:
- CLIENT_AUTHORISATION_LETTER (required)
- BENEFICIARY_COMPANY_KYC (required)
- BENEFICIARY_AGREEMENT (required)
- COLLECTOR_IDENTIFICATION (required if C2C)
- OPTIONAL_DOCUMENTATION (optional)

formdata.description: File to upload (PDF, JPG, PNG - max 10MB)

request.description:
Upload a KYC document for beneficiary.

**Form Data**:
- beneficiaryId (required)
- documentType (required)
- file (required, max 10MB)

**Allowed File Types**: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG

**Storage**: Google Cloud Storage (fincore-kyc-documents bucket)

**Status**: Document status will be PENDING

Delete a KYC document.

**Restriction**: Only PENDING or REJECTED documents can be deleted

**Side Effect**: Deletes file from Google Cloud Storage
